welcome.title: Let's build your store.
welcome.body: We'll guide you through a few quick steps — store details, storefront, your first product, payments, and shipping.

store.title: What's your store called?
store.body: This name appears on your storefront and invoices.
store.label: Store name
store.hint: You can change this anytime in Settings.

storefront.title: Choose your storefront
storefront.body: Pick a starting template. You can customize everything later in the Website Builder.

elementar.name: Modern Store
elementar.description: Fully customizable storefront with visual builder, colors, and content blocks.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: Polished conversion-focused storefront — ready to publish with your products.

floral.name: Floral Atelier
floral.description: Ultra-premium boutique storefront for florists — airy imagery and full checkout.

product.title: Add your first product
product.body: Your store needs at least one product before customers can shop.
product.successBody: It already appears in Products. You can add images and more details anytime.

payments.title: Accept card payments
payments.body: Connect Netopia so customers can pay by card at checkout.
payments.connectedBody: Netopia is linked to your store.
payments.failed: We couldn't connect your account yet.

shipping.title: Set up delivery
shipping.body: Connect eAWB to generate AWBs and offer delivery options to customers.
shipping.connectedBody: eAWB is linked to your store.
shipping.failed: We couldn't connect your account yet.

settings.title: Make your store feel complete
settings.body: Confirm your store name and add a logo. You can refine everything later.
settings.logoHint: Upload a square logo for your storefront header.

review.title: Your store is almost ready
review.body: Here's what you've set up. You can finish skipped items anytime.

ready.title: Your store is ready to go.
ready.body: You're all set to keep building from the Dashboard.
ready.bodyPartial: You can finish payments and shipping anytime from Settings.
